items.title: Portugal Immortalizes Cristiano Ronaldo's Legacy With a New No. 7 Jersey Design
items.summary:
Summary 

The Portugal Football Association has announced a graphic design update to its No. 7 jersey to honor Cristiano RonaldoBecause FIFA regulations prevent the outright retirement of the number, the new design features a small cross on the digitThe updated jersey will debut during the team's upcoming Nations League match against Denmark following Ronaldo's recent retirement

The Portugal Football Association has officially announced a design update to its iconic No. 7 jersey, serving as a permanent tribute to Cristiano Ronaldo 's storied international career. Debuting during the team's upcoming Nations League match against Denmark, the design shift marks Portugal's first game since the 41-year-old forward announced his retirement from the national team earlier this month.

Concluding his international run with a staggering 146 goals across 234 matches, Ronaldo stepped away from the squad on November 5 following a fallout with coach Jorge Jesus. Because strict FIFA stipulations prevent national federations from officially retiring jersey numbers, the governing body opted for a visual workaround to honor the athlete's legacy. The newly updated No. 7 kit features a modified graphic design that incorporates a small cross on the digit, symbolically drawing a line after Ronaldo's historic era.

"From today onwards, we will have a different number 7 on the jersey, but with the same essence and the same pride, reserving the previous one for the immortalization of a story that will never be forgotten," the federation shared in an official statement. While forward Rafael Leão…
items.t: Portugal Immortalizes Cristiano Ronaldo's Legacy With a New No. 7 Jersey Design

items.title: JW Anderson and Johnstons of Elgin Reimagine Archival Checks in New Coats and Knits
items.summary:
JW Anderson and historic luxury textile brand Johnstons of Elgin , hailing from northeastern Scotland, have unveiled a new Scottish-made capsule collection.

Rooted in an archival check pattern from Johnstons of Elgin, this collaboration fuses the distinct craftsmanship and design aesthetics both brands have cultivated over the years. The three-piece lineup features a coat, a sweater, and a scarf. Entirely produced in Scotland, the pieces combine traditional textile techniques with JW Anderson's signature graphic edge.

Crafted from the same raw materials as the knitwear, the coat renders a boldly oversized check pattern in a thick, substantial weave. Cut in a double-breasted silhouette, it features fringed edges that push the rich texture of the textile to the forefront.

The sweater reconstructs the coat's striking red check into a three-dimensional jacquard knit. By knitting the pattern on both the front and the back, the piece achieves a beautifully textured finish distinct from woven fabrics. The entire process, from knitting to the final touches, takes place at the Johnstons of Elgin mill in Hawick, a town in the Scottish Borders renowned for its cashmere production.

The scarf incorporates curated motifs from both brands' archives and current collections. It pairs a lamb illustration from a 1930s Johnstons of Elgin archive with the Ribbon Anchor that JW Anderson debuted in its Resort/Spring 2026 collection, seamlessly bringing together creative elements from different eras into a single, cohesive design.

The collection is slated for release at JW Anderson and…
items.t: JW Anderson and Johnstons of Elgin Reimagine Archival Checks in New Coats and Knits

items.title: Rowing Blazers x Grateful Dead Takes the Stealie Downhill
items.summary:
Summary 

Rowing Blazers and the Grateful Dead have teamed up on a winter capsule of a sherpa pullover and Stealie crewnecksThe fleece’s mountain scene is based on a vintage Grateful Dead tour teeThe Stealie logo is knit in intarsia on a merino wool and cashmere blend

Rowing Blazers has teamed up with the Grateful Dead on a cold-weather capsule built around the Clark Sherpa pullover and the Stealie Cashmere Sweater. Both pieces use classic Dead imagery, with the fleece carrying a mountain landscape and the knit centered on the band’s skull logo.

The Clark Sherpa is the standout piece, a pullover fleece in the classic Clark fit that runs slightly oversized. Its front has a mountain scenic jacquard artwork inspired by a vintage Grateful Dead tour T-shirt, so the design is woven into the pile instead of printed on top. The practical details are kept simple: a stand collar with snap-button placket, side seam pockets and a 100% polyester build, all in a single Blue colorway.

The Stealie knit is the quieter option. It’s a crewneck with the signature Grateful Dead Stealie logo knit in intarsia, which means the skull is knitted into the fabric, not applied as a patch or print. Despite the “cashmere” name, the yarn is a blend of 90% merino wool, 10% cashmere, finished with ribbing at the neckline, cuffs and hem. A co-branded Rowing Blazers and Grateful Dead main label sits inside, and the sweater comes in Heather Gray and Black.

The capsule’s taglines explain the mood. The fleece is pitched at Dead Heads of the downhill, an après-ski take on tour merch, while the knit leans…
items.t: Rowing Blazers x Grateful Dead Takes the Stealie Downhill

items.title: G-Star and Wu-Tang Clan’s “Code to Code” Drop Cuts Shaolin Discipline Into Raw Denim
items.summary:
Summary 

G-Star and Wu-Tang Clan have released the first drop of a multi-year collaboration developed with Iconic Artists GroupJapanese garment forms such as wrap constructions, hakama-style volume and kimono-based shapes are worked into G-Star’s denim engineeringEmbroidered waves, pagodas and martial arts figures sit beside the Wu-Tang “W” and a “Code to Code” signature

G-Star and Wu-Tang Clan have launched the first drop of their “Code to Code” collaboration, a raw indigo capsule that brings the group’s Shaolin influences into the Dutch denim label’s construction methods. The four-piece release opens a multi-year partnership developed with Iconic Artists Group. More collections are already planned.

Raw indigo denim forms the base of the debut lineup, and a zip-front jacket and wide-leg carpenter jeans lead the release. Both are cut with plenty of room, while functional details taken from workwear keep that volume practical. An oversized T-shirt and an indigo-washed sweatshirt complete the four pieces.

The shapes come from Wu-Tang’s Shaolin references, which pushed the design toward discipline, structure and ease of movement. G-Star worked that idea through traditional Japanese clothing, bringing wrap constructions, the fullness of hakama trousers and kimono-derived cuts into its denim engineering and workwear vocabulary. The result reads as martial arts uniform crossed with work garment, not a straightforward merch tie-in.

The embroidery does most of the storytelling, with waves, pagodas and martial arts figures stitched beside the group’s instantly recognizable “W”…

items.title: P1Harmony’s ‘BLOW UP’ Blasts In at a Career-Best No. 4 on the Billboard 200
items.summary:
Summary 

P1Harmony’s ‘BLOW UP’ debuts at No. 4 on the Billboard 200, tying the group’s highest position yetThe album opens with 45,000 equivalent album units, almost all from physical sales across 30 CD and vinyl variantsOlivia Rodrigo’s you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love takes a fifth week at No. 1 as Lil Baby’s ‘FRESH’ enters at No. 2

P1Harmony ’s BLOW UP debuts at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 chart dated November 21, tying the group’s best ranking on the all-genre albums list. It’s the act’s third top 10 album, and it also opens at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Album Sales chart, the group’s first time leading that list.

BLOW UP earned 45,000 equivalent album units in the tracking week ending November 12, per Luminate, and sales did nearly all the work. Traditional album sales made up 43,500 of that total. Streaming accounted for 1,500 SEA units, or 1.56 million on-demand official streams of the set’s songs, and track sales added only a negligible amount. Fans had plenty to collect, with the album released across 25 CD variants and five vinyl variants, each packed with extras such as photocards and posters, some of them randomized.

The No. 4 opening ties P1Harmony’s previous high, set when UNIQUE debuted and peaked in the same spot in March. The group’s other top 10 came in 2025, when EX reached No. 9.

Olivia Rodrigo stays at No. 1 as you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love logs a fifth nonconsecutive week at the top. That ties SOUR for the longest run among her three chart-toppers. It also gives the album more weeks at No. 1 than any other album released in…
items.t: P1Harmony’s ‘BLOW UP’ Blasts In at a Career-Best No. 4 on the Billboard 200

An open letter demanding the reinstatement of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has amassed over 131,000 signatures including support from prominent tech figures like Elon MuskThe Stand with Jensen campaign aims to push the board to reinstate Huang while an independent investigation establishes the facts surrounding his recent resignationOrganizers emphasize that his 33 years of leadership deserve fairness and accountability based on evidence rather than mob justice

An open letter advocating for the reinstatement of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has rapidly gained traction, garnering over 131,000 signatures as of November 15. The campaign, which includes endorsements from notable industry figures such as Tesla CEO Elon Musk , Replit CEO Amjad Masad, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney , demands due process following the executive's recent resignation amid intense public scrutiny.

The "Stand with Jensen" campaign asserts that its list of signatories includes more than 71,000 shareholders, 6,500 current employees, and approximately 1,200 former staff members. Organizers are petitioning the board to reinstate Huang as CEO while an independent investigation is conducted, noting they are "concerned that Jensen may have been forced out without due process and without even a few days to make his case." The petition calls for a fair hearing and a timely public explanation detailing the concerns, evidence, and how the interests of shareholders and employees were weighed.

The letter emphasizes that while decades of leadership do not place anyone above accountability,…

items.title: Adam Driver Calls Disney's Cancellation of 'The Hunt for Ben Solo' Criminal

Adam Driver has expressed his lingering disbelief over Disney canceling the planned Star Wars film 'The Hunt for Ben Solo'The actor stated that rejecting a pitch from acclaimed director Steven Soderbergh felt criminal to himDespite months of fan organizing and billboard campaigns the project remains shuttered as the creators move on to other ventures

Disney and its Star Wars franchise have faced lingering criticism from Adam Driver over the cancellation of the unproduced film The Hunt for Ben Solo . Reflecting on his darker experiences with the massive sci-fi property during a recent conversation with the Associated Press , the actor candidly expressed his disbelief regarding how the studio handled the shuttered project, which was developed alongside director Steven Soderbergh.

Driver, who previously praised the project as one of the coolest scripts he had ever been a part of, voiced his frustration over the decision to halt development after two and a half years of work. “For me it was: Steven Soderbergh wants to make a Star Wars film,” Driver explained. “What are we debating? It’s what it is. It’s criminal. Or it felt criminal. We’re all moving on. On to the next. And Steven already has something else that’s one of the best things he’s ever written.”

According to Driver, the Skywalker Saga follow-up was ultimately killed because Disney executives Bob Iger and Alan Bergman reportedly could not see how the character of Ben Solo was still alive. The cancellation sparked a massive fan response, which included organizing campaigns and physical billboards in Times…

Paramount has taken the top spot at the Friday box office with its new holiday release, Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol . Starring Johnny Depp as the iconic curmudgeon Scrooge, the PG-13 adaptation of the Charles Dickens classic A Christmas Carol led the domestic charts with $6.7 million USD on its opening day.

Directed by Ti West —a filmmaker best known for his work on the X horror trilogy—the film puts a fresh spin on the oft-told tale of a curmudgeonly businessman who is visited by the ghosts of Christmas past, present, and future. Produced on a modest $38 million USD budget, the picture is currently projected to earn between $18 million and $20 million USD across 3,535 North American theaters during its opening weekend. With an expected additional $20 million USD from overseas markets, Ebenezer is eyeing a solid global debut tally of around $38 million to $40 million USD.

NECA has officially unveiled its new 1:1 Scale Replica Baby Jason Voorhees Doll, drawing direct inspiration from the character's on-screen appearance in the hit Peacock and A24 series Crystal Lake .

The life-size prop replica captures the infant version of the iconic horror antagonist with meticulous detail. Designed with five points of articulation, the collectible figure features highly realistic skin and lifelike eyes to mirror his television counterpart. The piece arrives in collector-friendly window box packaging, which notably references Project Arnogaut and the horrific in-universe experiments that irrevocably changed Camp Crystal Lake forever.

The meticulously crafted doll arrives amidst the success of the Brad Caleb Kane-helmed television series, which explores the origins of the legendary slasher icon. Starring Linda Cardellini as Pamela Voorhees, the show follows the grieving single mother almost a year after her sickly son tragically drowned. When two strangers arrive digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion. By offering a true-to-scale physical translation of the infant character, NECA provides horror enthusiasts with a chilling, tangible piece of the new Crystal Lake lore.

items.title: Rory McIlroy Secures Record-Equalling Eighth Race to Dubai Title
items.summary:
Summary 

Rory McIlroy secured his eighth Race to Dubai title after a flawless fourth round at Jumeirah Golf EstatesThe victory marks his fifth consecutive European tour crown and equals Colin Montgomerie’s long-standing recordEugenio Chacarra finished tied for third as Tyrrell Hatton claimed the tournament win five shots ahead of McIlroy

Rory McIlroy has officially captured the Race to Dubai title for a record-equalling eighth time. Following a dramatic season finale at Jumeirah Golf Estates, the golfer secured his fifth successive European tour crown by overturning a points deficit to overtake Eugenio Chacarra.

Going into the final round, Chacarra held a slender 533.93-point lead over McIlroy. However, McIlroy overturned the deficit with a flawless, blemish-free fourth round of 67. He finished 10 under par to take sole possession of second place, while his Ryder Cup teammate Tyrrell Hatton stormed to the tournament victory, ending the day five shots ahead. Chacarra shot a final round of 69, featuring six birdies and three bogeys, bringing him to eight under and a tie for third.

Reflecting on matching Colin Montgomerie’s historic Order of Merit record, McIlroy shared his disbelief. "Winning eight Order of Merits (now called Race to Dubai) was never in my list of goals growing up," McIlroy noted. "I remember Monty being a stalwart of the European tour and playing with him at the London Club in 2008, so to pull up alongside him and win eight of these means the world to me. I'm proud to be European and part of this tour." Visibly emotional, McIlroy dedicated the…
items.t: Rory McIlroy Secures Record-Equalling Eighth Race to Dubai Title

Delving into the adidas outdoor archives, Brain Dead has reunited with adidas Originals to revive the ZUPERKLIMB. The collaborative silhouette arrives in three distinct colorways: "Green," " Brown" and "Core Black."

“Green” is the most vivid of the three, combining deep navy hairy suede flecked with green fibers and forest-green leather Three Stripes, a matching green eyestay, green laces and a green heel loop. “Brown” goes earthier, with tan suede, chocolate-brown leather stripes and eyestay, brown laces and a cream lining. “Core Black” is fully tonal, from the black suede and leather stripes down to the laces and rand, leaving the silver hardware and reflective details as the only contrast.

Originally designed for climbers, the low-profile silhouette keeps its technical roots, with lacing running down toward the toe for a more precise fit. A Stealth rubber outsole wraps up around the forefoot for added grip on trail, while adiPRENE foam provides cushioning underneath.

Brain Dead’s touch shows in the upper, which pairs the label’s signature shaggy, hairy suede with semi-open mesh for a tactile, slightly worn-in look. Silver speed hooks sit near the collar, reflective trim outlines the upper eyelets, and a pull loop rises from the heel. A thick black rubber rand runs around the base of the shoe, with Brain Dead’s head logo debossed into it at the heel.

items.title: Kengo Kuma’s KAI Water Culture House Is Built From Roughly 300,000 Handmade Bricks
items.summary:
Summary 

Kengo Kuma & Associates unveils Copenhagen's 5,800-square-meter KAI Water Culture House.The complex features handmade brick towers above a glazed base.Opening December 5, it offers ten pools and wellness facilities.

Kengo Kuma & Associates , in collaboration with Cornelius Vöge Atelier for Architecture and Vilhelm Lauritzen Architects , has announced the upcoming opening of the KAI Water Culture House in Copenhagen , Denmark. Set to officially open to the public on December 5, 2026, the expansive 5,800-square-meter facility is situated prominently on Papirøen (Paper Island).

Conceived as a major public waterfront destination, the monumental complex seamlessly combines ten distinct indoor and outdoor pools, comprehensive wellness facilities and versatile cultural spaces to establish a dynamic new focal point for recreation and community gathering within the city's rapidly transforming harbor. The project’s roots stretch back nearly a decade: in 2015, the City of Copenhagen asked residents to pitch ideas for a cultural and leisure venue on the island, drawing 160 submissions, many of which imagined a swimming facility that doubled as a place for relaxation and community.

Architecturally, the building reads as a cluster of five brick towers rising from a transparent, glazed base. Each tower takes its form from the pool positioned beneath it, giving every interior its own character while producing an irregular, stepped roofline across the skyline. items.title: Jess Cartner-Morley on fashion: this season’s big idea? Wear a skirt. It’s that simple
items.summary:
All you need to look on-trend this autumn is a skirt, but instead of going shopping, check what you already have in your wardrobe

I go to a lot of fashion shows, and sometimes they are gorgeous and sometimes they are ugly. Sometimes they are electrifying and sometimes they are deathly dull. Sometimes they are completely baffling. My absolute favourite kind of show is the one that makes me want to run home and change my outfit. A show that makes me think: there it is! That’s exactly what I want to wear. When the look speaks to me, as if it had been on the tip of my tongue. God, I love that.

Which is what happened at Prada this season. The idea was: skirts. That’s it, that’s the whole idea. The show was 63 different skirts – some with a sweater, some with a bra top, some with a jacket, but the point was the skirts. They were knee-length, give or take an inch up or down, and A-line, although sometimes a narrow almost-pencil and other times with a broader flare. There were skirts that wrapped like kilts, held together with strips of industrial-weight Velcro embroidered with tiny gems. There were stiff boxy pleated skirts and tube skirts painted with swirls, and dainty embellished skirts with a layer of gauze on top, like a petticoat worn on the outside.

Continue reading...
items.t: Jess Cartner-Morley on fashion: this season’s big idea? Wear a skirt. It’s that simple
